info.title: StellarYield API
info.description: REST API for StellarYield — indexes on-chain events and exposes vault, user, and yield data.

schema.description: Comma-separated list of up to 3 `field[:direction]` pairs, e.g. `state:asc,total_assets:desc`. Allowed fields: created_at, updated_at, total_assets, total_supply, state, name. A field with no explicit direction inherits `order`.
